title: AtlasTexture renders incorrect region on Sprite2D when created in code
body:
### Tested versions

This bug was found in Godot 4.4. I have not tested it on previous versions.

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400 (12 threads)

### Issue description

When an AtlasTexture is created in code and assigned to a Sprite2D node's texture property, the sprite renders an incorrect region of the source texture.

Specifically, it seems to render a tile from an adjacent column in the texture atlas. In the provided Minimal Reproduction Project (MRP), the code generates an AtlasTexture with a region pointing to column 4 of a sprite sheet. Debug prints confirm the AtlasTexture's region property is set correctly to Rect2(256, 0, 64, 64). However, the Sprite2D visually renders the tile from column 0 of the atlas.

I expect the Sprite2D to render the tile from the exact region specified by the AtlasTexture resource.

Code to generate the texture:

```
static func generate_armor_by_type(type_enum: Armor.Type) -> ItemData:
	var item = Armor.new()
	item.armor_type = type_enum
	
	var tier = 0
	
	var atlas := AtlasTexture.new()
	atlas.atlas = Armor.ARMOR_TEXTURE
	atlas.region = Armor.get_armor_icon_region(item.armor_type, tier)
	
	item.image = atlas
	item.name = generate_name(item)
	
	print("GENERATOR: Creating ", item.name, " (", item.armor_type, ") with region ", atlas.region)
	
	return item

```

Debug output showing the correct region data:

```
GENERATOR: Creating Boots (4) with region [P: (256.0, 0.0), S: (64.0, 64.0)]
UPDATING SPRITE: Type=4 (Boots), Region=[P: (256.0, 0.0), S: (64.0, 64.0)]

```

Despite this, the rendered sprite is from position (0, 0), not (256, 0).

### Steps to reproduce

Open the attached Minimal Reproduction Project (MRP).

Run the main scene (TestScene.tscn).

Observe the sprite that appears on the screen. The code is set to generate "Boots," which are in column 4 of the armor.png atlas.

Notice that the sprite displayed is "Chest" armor, which is from column 0.

Check the output log, which confirms the AtlasTexture region was correctly calculated for the "Boots" sprite.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[space_rocks_2025-07-16_22-29-56.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21272654/space_rocks_2025-07-16_22-29-56.zip)
